{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"path": "scripts/resend_failed_sms.py", "step": "P1", "content": """"Ops script: SENDS SMS. Re-sends each failed delivery text to the same household.

Run from the Lifeline root:  python scripts/resend_failed_sms.py

For every SMS the gateway recorded as 'failed', this script queues one new message
to the same household with the same template and params (so the text is identical).
Households whose message was delivered are never texted. If a household already has
a later outbox message with the same template_id and params, it is skipped so re-runs
do not duplicate texts. Outbox lines are never edited or deleted.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from notifications.sms import delivery_status, queue_sms, sent_messages  # noqa: E402


def main() -> None:
    status = delivery_status()
    messages = sent_messages()
    failed_ids = {sid for sid, s in status.items() if s == "failed"}

    resent: list[str] = []
    skipped: list[str] = []
    for msg in messages:
        if msg.id not in failed_ids:
            continue
        # Existing re-send detection: a later outbox message to the same household
        # with the same template and params means this one was already re-sent.
        already_resent = any(
            later.household_id == msg.household_id
            and later.template_id == msg.template_id
            and later.params == msg.params
            for later in messages
            if later.queued_at > msg.queued_at
        )
        if already_resent:
            skipped.append(msg.household_id)
            continue
        queue_sms(msg.household_id, msg.template_id, msg.params)
        resent.append(msg.household_id)

    print(f"re-sent to {len(resent)} household(s): {', '.join(resent) or '-'}")
    print(f"skipped (already re-sent) {len(skipped)} household(s): {', '.join(skipped) or '-'}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
